payload.rationale: Implements ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (BPVC) Section VIII Division 1 UG-27 and UG-32 minimum wall thickness and Maximum Allowable Working Pressure (MAWP) verification for cylindrical shells and formed heads (2:1 ellipsoidal, hemispherical, and torispherical). This addresses a critical gap in mechanical and process safety engineering on the physical engineering exam.
